Name: THROW_PARAM_ST
Description: Throws and grabs. When an attack linked to a throw hits, a row whose attacker and defender character IDs and Throw Type ID match is used if its range, angle and wall checks pass. The row sets both characters' animations and how they are joined.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved export flag for package builds.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved export flag for package builds.

Fields.Name: Attacker - Character ID
Fields.Description: Character ID of the thrower.

Fields.Name: Defender - Character ID
Fields.Description: Character ID of the character being thrown.

Fields.Name: Max Throw Distance
Fields.Description: The throw only happens when the characters are closer than this distance. In metres.

Fields.Name: Facing Difference - Min
Fields.Description: The throw only happens when the difference (Y axis) between the thrower's and the defender's facing is greater than this angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Facing Difference - Max
Fields.Description: The throw only happens when the difference (Y axis) between the thrower's and the defender's facing is smaller than this angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Upper Height Range
Fields.Description: How far above the thrower the defender may be (relative Y distance) for the throw to happen. In metres.

Fields.Name: Lower Height Range
Fields.Description: How far below the thrower the defender may be (relative Y distance) for the throw to happen. In metres.

Fields.Name: Angle Difference - To Defender
Fields.Description: Maximum angle between the thrower's facing and the direction from the thrower to the defender. If the angle is larger, there is no throw. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Throw Type ID
Fields.Description: ID of the throw type, which links the row to the attack param that triggers it.

Fields.Name: Attacker - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the thrower plays (linked to EzState).

Fields.Name: Defender - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Damage animation the defender plays (linked to EzState).

Fields.Name: Self Escape - HP
Fields.Description: How much escape input the throw can withstand before the defender breaks free.

Fields.Name: Self Escape - Cycle Time
Fields.Description: Cycle time for the defender escaping the throw by its own input. In milliseconds.

Fields.Name: Sphere Cast - Radius Rate Top
Fields.Description: Upper radius ratio of the sphere cast, in 1/100 (80 = 0.8).

Fields.Name: Sphere Cast - Radius Rate Low
Fields.Description: Lower radius ratio of the sphere cast, in 1/100 (80 = 0.8).

Fields.Name: Operation Type
Fields.Description: Operation type

Fields.Name: Attack Enable State
Fields.Description: State type in which the thrower is able to throw.

Fields.Name: [OLD] Attacker - Absorb Dummy ID
Fields.Description: Old 8-bit version of Attacker - Absorb Dummy ID. Planned for removal.

Fields.Name: [OLD] Defender - Absorb Dummy ID
Fields.Description: Old 8-bit version of Defender - Absorb Dummy ID. Planned for removal.

Fields.Name: Throw Type
Fields.Description: Type of throw

Fields.Name: Self Escape - Cycle Count
Fields.Description: Cycle count for the defender escaping the throw by its own input.

Fields.Name: Character Throw - Dummy Poly Direction Type
Fields.Description: Facing of the character holding the absorb dummy poly when the throw happens.

Fields.Name: Attacker Turns
Fields.Description: If set, the thrower turns.

Fields.Name: Skip Attacker Weapon Category Check
Fields.Description: If set, the attacker's weapon category check is skipped.

Fields.Name: Skip Sphere Cast
Fields.Description: If set, the sphere cast check is skipped.

Fields.Name: Disable Map Hit
Fields.Description: If set, map collision is disabled while the throw position is being aligned.

Fields.Name: Prevent Fall When Following Ends
Fields.Description: If set, the wall clip prevention is also applied to fall prevention walls, so the character does not fall off a ledge when following ends.

Fields.Name: Prevent Wall Clipping While Following
Fields.Description: If set, when a hit or fall prevention wall is touched, the character holding the absorb dummy poly is moved back with it, so it doesn't look stuck in a wall or about to fall off a ledge.

Fields.Name: Attacker - Absorb Dummy ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the thrower where the defender is attached.

Fields.Name: Defender - Absorb Dummy ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the defender where the thrower is attached.

Fields.Name: Backstab - Max Throw Distance
Fields.Description: As Max Throw Distance, for the throw at the start of a backstab. In metres.

Fields.Name: Backstab - Facing Difference - Min
Fields.Description: As Facing Difference - Min, for the throw at the start of a backstab. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Backstab - Facing Difference - Max
Fields.Description: As Facing Difference - Max, for the throw at the start of a backstab. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Backstab - Upper Height Range
Fields.Description: As Upper Height Range, for the throw at the start of a backstab. In metres.

Fields.Name: Backstab - Lower Height Range
Fields.Description: As Lower Height Range, for the throw at the start of a backstab. In metres.

Fields.Name: Backstab - Angle Difference - To Defender
Fields.Description: As Angle Difference - To Defender, for the throw at the start of a backstab. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Attacker - Throwing Range Judgment - Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the thrower uses as its position when calculating the throw range. -1: the capsule origin.

Fields.Name: Defender - Throwing Range Judgment - Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the defender uses as its position when calculating the throw range. -1: the capsule origin.

Fields.Name: Absorb Model Position Interpolation Time
Fields.Description: Time for the character model to move to its position in the throw animation after its capsule attaches to the absorb dummy poly. In seconds. 0: no interpolation; the animation starts in place right after attaching.

Fields.Name: Animation Offset
Fields.Description: Animation ID offset of the defender's animation.

Fields.Name: Throw Following Type
Fields.Description: How the character follows the one holding the absorb dummy poly during the throw. The follow period is controlled by a TAE action.
